description.value: A family-run Indian restaurant opened in 2004 by Kewal and Surinder Sandhu, who brought their love of authentic Indian cooking from their homeland to Burnaby's Kingsway corridor. Voted Burnaby's best Indian restaurant for over 20 years, it serves a broad menu of tandoor dishes, curries, seafood, and vegetarian fare alongside a full bar. The restaurant is wheelchair accessible and features a patio along a busy commercial strip.
